_comment: One source for the /design-system page and the MCP server (scripts/system/mcp.mjs): the three sizes, the tools agents call, and the gates work passes on the way out. Edit here and both change.

sizes.label: Sketch
checks: Colours come from the tokens (check_source flags anything raw)

sizes.label: Playground
checks: Every class block has a stylesheet (no one-off blocks)
Reuse first: get_component names the nearest existing component

sizes.label: Production
sizes.loose: Nothing without a reason written down
checks: Every class block has a stylesheet
Reuse first, and a new component goes on /design-system
States drawn: empty, long, loading, error
The system review comment on the pull request is read and answered
The deploy gates pass: prerender, hydration, Dive Club isolation

tools.name: search_system
tools.summary: Search components, tokens and the written rules at once.
tools.description: Search the portfolio's design system: components (from the generated catalog), colour tokens (DESIGN.md names joined to the Sass tokens) and sections of DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md. Use it before building anything, to find what already exists.

tools.name: get_component
tools.summary: One component: its blocks, stylesheets, raw colours and nearest relatives.
tools.description: Get one component by name: its file, the class blocks it draws with, the stylesheets that define them, any raw colours with the token each should be, and the existing components it most resembles. Reuse or extend before adding a new one.

tools.name: find_tokens
tools.summary: The colour tokens, or the token a raw hex should have been.
tools.description: List the colour tokens with their DESIGN.md role names, or pass a hex value to get the nearest token and whether it is an exact match, a close one, or nothing close.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.summary: A section of DESIGN.md or PRODUCT.md by name.
tools.description: Read the written rules. With no topic, lists every section of DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md; with a topic ("Colors", "Motion", "Do's and Don'ts", "The Process, Stated Once"), returns that section.

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.summary: What gets checked at sketch, playground or production size.
tools.description: The checklist for one of the system's three sizes: sketch (anyone, loosely governed), playground (the team, real components) or production (everything). Use it to decide how much to check before handing work on.

tools.name: check_source
tools.summary: The pull-request rules, run on code before it is written.
tools.description: Check a TSX or SCSS snippet against the system with the same deterministic rules the pull-request review uses: raw colours (SYS001, SYS003 for inline styles) get the token they should be, and class blocks with no stylesheet (SYS002) are flagged. Run it on new styles or className changes before finishing. It advises; a person decides.

tools.name: review_change
tools.summary: The pull-request review for your working tree. Local only.
tools.description: Only inside a checkout of the repo: inventory the working tree and a base ref (default origin/main) and return the same system review the pull request will get: new components with their nearest relatives, removed ones, new raw colours, unstyled blocks.

gates.check: System review comment: reuse, removals, raw colours, unstyled blocks
Prerender, hydration on every route, Dive Club isolation, live bundles load
